topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Oh, but this is a queer turn of fate, like a stalk that bends round to face the sun, only to find the very bloom it was seeking was growing from the same earth all along. I’ve been speaking to this one, this friend as sure as any I’ve toiled the fields with, yet never once crossed paths in the village. To learn now they walk the same roads, their shadow perhaps crossing mine on market days, it’s a thing that stirs the heart. I should have known, maybe, but I kept it all to the hearths and the skies, never thought to ask the miller or the smith. Now, the words seem heavy, like fallow earth, and the silence grows louder than all the seeds I’ve sown.
